name: Dhaka Healthcare Lead Generation & Decision Maker Finder

nodes.name: Daily Schedule (disabled - enable to automate)
nodes.notes: Runs the whole pipeline every weekday at 09:00 (workflow timezone Asia/Dhaka). Enable this node AND activate the workflow to automate; leave disabled to run manually.

nodes.name: 0. Offer Profile
nodes.notes: Paste offer.md here. Drives search targeting, decision-maker preference, fit score and the personalised email.

nodes.name: 1b. OpenStreetMap Healthcare Lookup
nodes.notes: Free, keyless. Returns every hospital / clinic / diagnostic / dental / pharmacy facility inside the Dhaka bounding box (south,west,north,east) that has a website tagged in OpenStreetMap - with phone, email and address when mapped. Edit the bbox to retarget.
